blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates salient factors specific to the target from common content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. On Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ eyeglasses, SAGE combines high-fidelity reconstruction (rFID below 2 2 ) with unsupervised subtype discovery , recovering the digits better than baselines (probe accuracy 0.950 0.950 vs. at most 0.281 0.281 ) and revealing eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and mislabeled images; salient-conditioned generation raises Digits-ImageNet subtype accuracy over the unfactorized latent ( 90.5 % 90.5\% vs. 27.7 % 27.7\% ) and diversity on both datasets. On retinal OCT, SAGE’s salient space separates three diseases using only normal/disease labels.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个目标数据集,例如有眼镜的面孔,以及一个背景数据集,例如没有面孔的面孔,对比性分析将目标特有的显著因素与双方共享的共同内容区分开来. 我们的目标是能捕捉到每个图像中特定目标细节的显著表现,如眼镜的形状,颜色,和位置等,这样可以揭示没有子类型标签的子类型,并引导被发现子类型的新实例的生成,即使是没有名字或文字描述的子类型. 我们引入SAGE,它直接从被冻结的表示自编码器的高维空间潜伏中学习出两个因素,同时将传播变压器作为参考图像所学到的显著表现条件。 在Digits-ImageNet和FFHQ眼镜上,SAGE将高真性重建(rFID under 2 2 )与无监督的子类型发现相结合,恢复到比基线更好的数字(精确度约为0.950 0.950,最多为0.281 0.281),并揭示出眼衣类型,更细的太阳镜样式,以及有错误标签的图像;有显著条件的一代提高了Digits-ImageNet子类型的准确度,高于未构件的潜质(90.5% 90.5\%=27.7\%)和两个数据集的多样性。 在视网膜OCT中,SAGE的显著空间只用正常/疾病标签区分出三种疾病.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Learning what two data distributions share and what sets one apart is central to multimodal learning ( Dufumier et al., 2025 ) , domain adaptation ( Lee et al., 2021 ) , and disentanglement ( Sanchez et al., 2020 ) . Contrastive analysis (CA) poses this problem with dataset labels alone: given a target and a background dataset, it separates salient factors z s z_{s} specific to the target from common factors z c z_{c} shared by both. For faces with and without eyeglasses as target and background (Fig. 1 ), z s z_{s} should capture eyewear-related variation (e.g., frame style and color) and z c z_{c} the content both groups share (e.g., identity, pose, and scene). The stakes are especially high in medicine, where clinical group labels may be available even when the corresponding imaging differences remain unknown. Autism, for instance, is diagnosed from behavior, which tells us who is affected but not how their brains differ; contrasting brain MRI of the autism and control groups can reveal these differences ( Aglinskas et al., 2022 ) . Such patterns are subtle, hard to describe in words, and not known in advance, yet finding them could provide objective imaging markers, deepen the understanding of a disease, and even uncover its subtypes. blocks.en: Can we learn salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, reveal subtypes without labels, and generate new examples of what they discover?
blocks.zh: 我们能否学习突出的表达方式,捕捉每个图像中特定目标的细节,揭示没有标签的子类型,并产生它们发现的新的例子?

blocks.en: Answering it requires a representation that is semantically rich enough for discovery and decodable back to images, and existing CA methods offer complementary strengths toward these goals: generative CA models ( Abid and Zou, 2019 ; Louiset et al., 2023 ; Carton et al., 2024 ) decode their factors but reconstruct complex natural images poorly, and contrastive CA methods ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) learn semantically rich factors but have no decoder. In this work, we propose SAGE ( Sa lient factor discovery and Ge neration), a contrastive analysis approach that factorizes the frozen spatial latent z z of a representation autoencoder (RAE), RAEv2 ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , into z c z_{c} and z s z_{s} , whose sum the frozen RAE decoder maps back to images. Built on a pretrained foundation encoder, DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , this latent is semantically rich, keeps a high-dimensional spatial layout in which salient factors can retain instance-level detail such as the shape, color, and position of a particular pair of glasses, decodes with high fidelity, and supports state-of-the-art diffusion generation ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 回答它需要一种非常丰富,足以发现和可解码回向图像的表达方式,而现有的CA方法为实现这些目标提供了互补的优势:基因CA模型(Abid and Zou, 2019;Louiset等, 2023;Carton等, 2024)解码了它们的因素,但重建了复杂的自然图像,具有对比性的CA方法(Louiset等, 2024)学习了基因上丰富的因素,但没有解码. 在这部作品中,我们提出SAGE(sa levent facters discoveration and Ge neration),一种对比分析方法,将一个代表自编码器(RAE)被冻结的空间潜在z z,RAEv2(Singh等,2026年)被分解为z c z_{c}和z s s s},将被冻结的RAE解码器地图的总和归为图像. 这种潜想以预先训练的地基编码器(Siméoni等,2025年)所建,这种潜想非常丰富,保持了高维空间布局,其中突出因素可以保留一对特定眼镜的形状,颜色和位置等实例级细节,解码有很高的忠诚度,并支持最先进的传播生成(郑等等,2026年;辛格等,2026年).

blocks.en: This latent, however, mixes target-specific variation with all other image content ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Separating the two is nontrivial: reconstruction alone is already satisfied by an empty z s z_{s} , a high-dimensional z s z_{s} can easily absorb shared content, and it can capture only a generic template of the attribute while instance-specific detail stays in z c z_{c} . SAGE counters these failures with objectives that include swapping salient factors between background and target images, keeping them sparse, and requiring them to be recoverable after the swap. The learned salient factors cleanly separate target-specific content and reveal subtypes, and they can be swapped or removed to edit individual images. SAGE can further generate images. Because the salient variation is often not known in advance and has no name or text description, instruction- or prompt-conditioned generation ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) cannot even be applied; instead, in a second stage, SAGE conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image to generate new images that keep its salient subtype while their common content varies. This in turn indicates that the salient condition carries little of the reference’s shared content.

SAGE可以进一步生成图像. 由于显著变异往往不事先知道,且没有名称或文字描述,指令-或即时条件生成(刘等,2023;吴等,2025;)甚至无法被应用;相反地,在第二阶段,SAGE在所学到的显著表示参考图像上设定了扩散变异器,以生成新的图像,保持其显著子类型,而其共同内容却各不相同. 这反过来表明,这一突出条件几乎没有参考的共同内容。

blocks.en: Our contributions answer each part of the question above: (1) Learning clean, high-fidelity salient factors : salient factors decode to only the digit or eyeglasses, and together with the common factors they reconstruct Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ images with rFID below 2 2 , versus above 120 120 for generative CA baselines. (2) Revealing subtypes without labels : on Digits-ImageNet, the salient space recovers the ten digits far better than a contrastive CA baseline on the same encoder (probe accuracy 0.950 0.950 vs. 0.148 0.148 ); on FFHQ, it separates eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and a mislabeled cluster; and on retinal OCT, it distinguishes three diseases. (3) Generating what is discovered : on Digits-ImageNet, conditioning on a reference’s salient representation, without text prompts or subtype labels, preserves its subtype far more often and produces more varied samples than the unfactorized latent (subtype accuracy 90.5 % 90.5\% vs. 27.7 % 27.7\% ; Vendi 12.50 12.50 vs. 2.65 2.65 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的发言回答了上述问题的每个部分: (1) 学习清洁、高纯度的突出因素:显著因素只将数字或眼镜解码,以及它们重建数字-ImageNet和FFHQ图像的常见因素,RFID低于2, 而基因CA基线为120,120以上。 (2)无标签地揭示子类型 : 在Digits-ImageNet上,显著的空间比同编码器上对比的CA基线(probe精度0.950 0.950 vs.0.148 0148)恢复十位数要好得多;在FFHQ上,它分离出眼衣类型,更细的太阳镜风格,以及被误贴标签的集群;在视网膜OCT上,它区分出三种疾病. (3) 生成发现的东西:在Digits-ImageNet上,对参考物的显著代表条件,没有文字提示或子类型标签,保留其子类型的次数要多得多,并产生比未构型潜入物更多的样本(子类型精度为90.5%90.5+=27.7%;Vendi 12.50 12.50 vs 2.65 2.65)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Contrastive analysis (CA) separates factors shared by background and target datasets from target-specific ones using only dataset labels, with applications in neuroimaging ( Aglinskas et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) and disease subgroup discovery ( Louiset et al., 2026 ) . cVAE ( Abid and Zou, 2019 ) , SepVAE ( Louiset et al., 2023 ) , and Double-InfoGAN ( Carton et al., 2024 ) learn the factors with a generator trained from scratch; SepCLR ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) learns strong salient representations under the InfoMax principle but has no decoder, and adding a reconstruction objective weakens its factor separation. CS-StyleGAN ( He et al., 2025 ) separates factors in an inverted StyleGAN latent and refines reconstructions with input features, and the concurrent Diff-CA ( Soumm et al., 2026 ) decomposes compact conditioning tokens of a diffusion generator. These methods represent the salient factor as a low-dimensional vector or global token; SAGE factorizes the full spatial latent of a frozen RAE and uses it for both discovery and generation.
blocks.zh: 对比分析(CA)将背景和目标数据集共享的因子与仅使用数据集标签的特定因子区分开来,在神经成像(Aglinskas等,2022;Zhu等,2026)和疾病分族发现(Louiset等,2026). cVAE(Abid和Zou等,2019),SepVAE(Louiset等,2023),和双信息GAN(Carton等,2024)中应用了从零开始训练的生成器来学习因子;SepCLR(Louiset等,2024)在InfoMax原则下学习了强烈的显著表现,但没有解码器,并添加了重建目标削弱了其因子分离. CS-StyleGAN (英语). (他等,2025年)在倒置的StyleGAN潜伏中分离出各种因子并精炼出带有输入特性的重建,并同时分解出Diff-CA(Soumm等,2026年)分解出一个扩散生成器的紧凑调节符. 这些方法代表了作为低维向量或全球标志物的显著因素;SAGE将被冻结的RAE的全部空间潜伏物作为要素,并用于发现和生成.

blocks.en: Recent work replaces the VAE of latent diffusion with frozen pretrained encoders ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) ; RAEs pair such encoders with ViT decoders that match or exceed standard VAEs ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and RAEv2 adds REPA ( Singh et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . SAGE factorizes this latent rather than only generating in it. Representation-conditioned generation ( Li et al., 2024 ) conditions on a full self-supervised representation, and diffusion editing ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) changes prompt-specified attributes; SAGE instead conditions on a discovered salient representation, specifying a subtype by example.
blocks.zh: 近期的工作用被冻结的事先训练的编码器取代了潜在扩散的VAE(Zheng等人,2026年;Tong等人,2026年;Shi等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年;RAEs将这种编码器与符合或超过标准的VAE(郑等人,2026年)相配,RAEv2增加了REPA(Singh等人,2026年;Yu等人,2025年)。 SAGE将这种潜在的因素考虑进去,而不是仅仅产生这种潜在因素。 具有代表条件的一代(Li等,2024年)在完全自我监督的表示上的条件,并进行传播编辑(Meng等,2022年;Wu等,2025年)会改变即时特定属性;SAGE转而在已发现的显著表示上的条件,逐个指定子类型.

blocks.en: SAGE needs a latent that is semantically expressive for discovery and decodable for reconstruction, manipulation, and generation. Unlike the VAE latents of standard latent diffusion, which are trained for reconstruction and carry limited semantic structure ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , RAEs pair frozen pretrained visual encoders with trained decoders, providing both properties and supporting high-quality latent diffusion ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) . We use the frozen RAEv2 encoder and decoder ( Singh et al., 2026 ) : E E is DINOv3-L ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) with multi-layer summation (MLS), and D D reconstructs images from z z . We factorize this spatial latent directly, without a learned bottleneck, to retain localized salient content (Fig. 4 ); freezing E E and D D attributes decoded changes to the learned factors and lets Stage 2 reuse RAEv2’s pretrained diffusion transformer.

blocks.en: We evaluate on Digits-ImageNet , ImageNet images with and without an overlaid MNIST digit (ten digit subtypes) ( LeCun et al., 1998 ; Deng et al., 2009 ) ; FFHQ faces with and without eyeglasses (reading glasses or sunglasses) ( Karras et al., 2019 ; DCGM, ) ; and OCT-Kermany normal retinal scans versus scans of three diseases (CNV, DME, and DRUSEN) ( Kermany et al., 2018 ) . Subtype labels are used only for evaluation (Appendix B.1 ). We measure reconstruction by rFID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) ; subtype discovery by Salient LP and ARI ( Hubert and Arabie, 1985 ) /NMI ( Strehl and Ghosh, 2002 ) of k k -means clusters; and generation by gFID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , generated-image subtype accuracy, and within-condition Vendi score ( Friedman and Dieng, 2023 ) (Appendices B.4 , B.5 , and D.2 ).

blocks.en: We compare with cVAE, SepVAE, Double-InfoGAN, and SepCLR ( Abid and Zou, 2019 ; Louiset et al., 2023 ; Carton et al., 2024 ; Louiset et al., 2024 ) , as well as DINOv3 + SepCLR and unfactorized DINOv3 features. Full implementation details appear in Appendices B.2 , C , and D .

blocks.en: Among decoder-based methods, only SAGE separates the target attribute cleanly (Fig. 4 ; additional randomly selected examples in Appendix Fig. A.1 ): it reconstructs scenes and faces with their digits or eyeglasses, common-only decoding removes only the target attribute, and salient-only decoding renders the digit or eyeglasses alone at their original location and shape. Generative baselines blur reconstructions and alter the scene or face even in common-only decoding; their salient-only outputs show no recognizable digit on Digits-ImageNet and blurred eyeglasses with much of the face on FFHQ, indicating common-content leakage. At the dataset level, SAGE’s salient t-SNE separates background from target images (Fig. 5 a, d), as the sparsity prior drives background salient factors toward zero; those of cVAE and, on Digits-ImageNet, SepVAE mix the two (Appendix Fig. 10 ).
blocks.zh: 在以解码器为基础的方法中,只有SAGE将目标属性干净地分离出来(图4;附录图中额外随机选取的例子. A.1):它用数字或眼镜来重建场景和面相,常见的只有去除目标属性的解码,而显著的只有去解码使得数字或眼镜在原来的位置和形状上单独出现. 基因基线模糊了重建,甚至改变场景或面相,即使是在普通的解码中;其显著的唯能输出显示在Digits-ImageNet上没有识别出的数字,并模糊了有FFHQ上许多面相的眼镜,表明常见内容的渗出. 在数据集层面,SAGE的显著t-SNE将背景与目标图像(图5 a, d)区分开来,因为前作会推动背景显著因素走向零;CVAE和Digits-ImageNet上的SepVAE将两者相混合(附录图10)。

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows t-SNE ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) of salient representations, colored by dataset label and, for targets, subtype labels used only for visualization. Background–target separation (Fig. 5 a, d; Section 4.2 ) does not imply subtype separation: SepCLR and DINOv3 + SepCLR also separate the datasets, yet their target digits remain mixed (Appendix A.3 ). SAGE recovers the expected subtypes: the ten digit identities form locally coherent, partly overlapping groups, and reading glasses and sunglasses form two separate groups (Fig. 5 b, e); raw z z separates neither (Fig. 5 c, f). Samples from each group (Fig. 5 g, h) share the digit or eyewear type while their scenes and faces differ, so the grouping follows the target attribute rather than shared content.

SAGE恢复了预期的子类型:十位数身份组成了局部一致,部分重叠的组,而读取眼镜和太阳镜则组成了两个独立的组(图5b,e;生z z两者都不相分离(图5c,f). 各组的样本(图5克,h)分享了数字或眼衣类型,而其场景和相貌则不同,因此分组遵循的是目标属性而不是共享内容.

blocks.en: Beyond reading glasses and sunglasses, the FFHQ t-SNE contains cluster C (Fig. 5 e, h), whose images lack eyeglasses but whose automatic annotations label them as wearing glasses, often because of face paint or hat-brim shadows (Appendix Fig. 13 c). This cluster led us to audit all 3,437 target validation images: annotators labeled the visible eyewear without seeing SAGE’s assignments and corrected 125 labels (3.64%; all corrections are shown in Appendix Fig. 12 ), including 39 no-glasses images; SAGE places 34 of these 39 in cluster C, while the other five show face paint or masks around the eyes (Appendix Fig. 13 a, b). With k = 3 k=3 , including no-glasses images, SAGE reaches ARI/NMI 0.937 / 0.865 0.937/0.865 , whereas every baseline remains below 0.46 / 0.56 0.46/0.56 ; e.g., DINOv3 + SepCLR drops from 0.915 / 0.825 0.915/0.825 to 0.453 / 0.550 0.453/0.550 (Appendix Table 4 ). SAGE thus also exposes label noise; Table 1 uses the audit-corrected labels for all methods.

blocks.en: 4.4 Factor Manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.4 因素操纵

blocks.en: Figure 6: Salient swapping and erasure.
blocks.zh: 图6:活性交换和去除。

blocks.en: Because both factors live in the latent space of the frozen decoder, the salient factor can be moved between images, removed, or interpolated, and the result decoded directly. We test whether such edits change only the target attribute. Swapping and erasure. Adding a target image’s salient factor to a background image transfers its particular attribute (Fig. 6 , left): a digit 7 retains its location and stroke shape, and thick black frames, rather than generic glasses, appear on a new face while the scene and identity remain. Conversely, zeroing a target’s salient factor removes the digit or reading glasses while preserving the rest (Fig. 6 , right; more in Fig. 14 ). These edits illustrate that each salient factor carries its own image’s target attribute and little else. Interpolation. Interpolating salient factors of two target images while retaining the first common factor changes mainly the target attribute (Fig. 7 , salient-only rows): a digit turns from 1 to 7 on a fixed photograph, and clear reading glasses darken into sunglasses on a fixed face. Interpolating both factors cross-fades the whole image (full-latent rows). Salient interpolation thus traverses subtypes while preserving common content.
blocks.zh: 由于这两种因素都活在被冻结的解码器的潜伏空间中,显著因素可以在图像之间移动,去除,或插入,结果直接解码. 我们测试这种编辑是否只改变目标属性 。 刮去和去除。 将目标图像的显著因素添加到背景图像中会转移出它的特殊属性(图6,左):一个数字7保留了它的位置和中风形状,而粗黑相框而不是通用相框,在场景和身份不变时会出现在新面孔上. 反之,将目标的显著因素去除去去数字或读取眼镜,同时保留其余的(图6,右;更用图14)。 这些编辑说明,每个显著因素都带有自己的图像目标属性,而几乎没有其他特征。 内分泌. 将两个目标图像的显著因素内插,同时保留了第一个共同因素,主要改变目标属性(图7,仅显行):一个数字从固定相片上的1到7,清晰的读取眼镜会暗入固定相片上的太阳镜. 将这两个因素都横跨了整个图像(全相通行). 因此,显著的插值在保留共同内容的同时会穿过子类型。

blocks.en: 4.5 Discovering Disease Subtypes in Retinal OCT
blocks.zh: 4.5 视网膜OCT中的分型疾病

blocks.en: Figure 8: OCT disease subtypes and salient edits. Left: salient t-SNE of disease scans, colored by disease subtype labels unused in training. BG → \to TG adds a disease scan’s salient factor to a normal scan; TG → \to BG removes a disease scan’s salient factor.
blocks.zh: 图8:OCT疾病子类型和显著编辑. 左:显著的T-SNE疾病扫描,由训练中未使用的疾病子类型标签所取色. BG →\to TG 在正常扫描中增加了疾病扫描的显著因子;TG →\to BG去除疾病扫描的显著因子.

blocks.en: Unlike digits and eyeglasses, retinal disease subtypes are clinically subtle and vary across patients. On OCT-Kermany, SAGE is trained only with normal/disease labels. Disease subtypes. Its salient space separates the three diseases, with t-SNE groups that overlap mainly at their boundaries (Fig. 8 , left), a linear-probe accuracy of 0.960 0.960 , and ARI/NMI 0.415 / 0.415 0.415/0.415 (Appendix A.7 ). Disease-specific edits. Adding a disease scan’s salient factor to a normal scan introduces fluid-filled cavities, while removing it yields a retina closer to normal (Fig. 8 , middle and right), suggesting disease-related features rather than patient-specific anatomy. These edits are qualitative, not clinical evidence.
blocks.zh: 与数字和眼镜不同,视网膜疾病亚型在临床上是微妙的并因患者而异. 在OCT-Kermany上,SAGE只接受正常/疾病标签的训练. 疾病亚型. 它的显著空间将三种疾病分开来,T-SNE组主要在它们的边界上重叠(图8,左),线性探测精度为0.960 0.960;ARI/NMI 0.415 / 0.415 0.415/0.415(附录A.7). 疾病特有编辑. 将疾病扫描的显著因素加入到正常扫描中,引入了充满流体的腔道,而去除它则产生更接近正常的视网膜(图8,中和右),暗示了与疾病相关的特征而不是针对病人的解剖. 这些编辑是定性的,不是临床证据.

blocks.en: Representation-conditioned generation ( Li et al., 2024 ) conditions on a full self-supervised representation; we instead condition on SAGE’s pooled salient representation c s c_{s} . Raw DINOv3 GMP pools the unfactorized latent z z identically, testing whether factorization removes reference face or scene information. Qualitative results. Salient conditioning generates new faces and scenes that keep the reference digit or eyewear type, whereas Raw DINOv3 GMP reproduces the reference person or scene almost exactly and often changes the digit (Appendix Fig. 15 ); Fig. 3 (top right) shows several samples per reference. Quantitative results. On Digits-ImageNet, salient conditioning raises subtype accuracy from 27.7 % 27.7\% to 90.5 % 90.5\% and Vendi from 2.65 2.65 to 12.50 12.50 (real: 15.79 15.79 ), and lowers Cos-to-ref from 0.794 0.794 to 0.116 0.116 (Table 2 ). On FFHQ, both conditions preserve eyewear type ( 96.6 % 96.6\% versus 98.5 % 98.5\% ), but only salient conditioning produces varied samples (Vendi 6.96 6.96 versus 2.32 2.32 ; Cos-to-ref 0.470 0.470 versus 0.779 0.779 ). Since the two conditions differ only in the salient encoder, reduced copying supports z s z_{s} as a more selective condition. Raw DINOv3 GMP attains lower conditional gFID, consistent with closer reference copying rather than subtype control, while SAGE has lower unconditional gFID on both datasets.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented SAGE, which learns salient factors in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder using only background/target labels. Its factors faithfully reconstruct and edit individual images. Without subtype labels, its salient representation recovers digits, eyewear types, and retinal diseases, reveals finer sunglasses styles and mislabeled images, and conditions the generation of new images that keep a discovered subtype while common content varies.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SAGE,它只用背景/目标标签来学习冷冻代表自动编码器在高维空间潜伏中的突出因素。 它的因素忠实地重建和编辑了单个图像. 没有子类型标签,它的显著表现恢复了位数,眼衣类型和视网膜疾病,揭示出更细的太阳镜样式和被误贴标签的图像,并且为保留被发现的子类型而同时常见内容不一的新图像的生成创造了条件.

blocks.en: Appendix B Datasets, Baselines, and Evaluation Details

blocks.en: B.1 Dataset Details
blocks.zh: B.1 数据集细节

blocks.en: For all datasets, training uses only background/target labels. Subtype labels are used only for evaluation and are not provided during representation learning.
blocks.zh: 对所有数据集,训练只使用背景/目标标签. 子型标签仅用于评价,在代表学习期间不提供.

blocks.en: We construct the target dataset by superimposing MNIST digits on ImageNet photographs; the background dataset contains photographs without added digits. We retain the ImageNet training and validation splits and randomly assign approximately half of each split to each dataset, using different random seeds for the training and validation splits. Background and target datasets use disjoint source photographs. All available ImageNet class directories are included, with no explicit class exclusions.
blocks.zh: 我们在ImageNet照片上用超强的 MNIST 数字构建目标数据集;背景数据集包含没有添加数字的照片. 我们保留了ImageNet的培训和验证拆分,并随机将每个拆分的大约一半分配到每个数据集,使用不同的随机种子进行培训和验证拆分. 背景和目标数据集使用不相干源相片. 包含所有可用的ImageNet类目录,没有明确的类排除.

blocks.en: Photographs are center-cropped to a square and resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. Each target receives one MNIST example sampled uniformly with replacement. Training images use the MNIST training set, while validation images use the MNIST test set. Digits are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels using bilinear interpolation and rendered in white. The top-left coordinates are sampled uniformly from { 0 , … , 288 } \{0,\ldots,288\} along each axis, keeping the digit patch within the image. We use the resized digit intensities as an alpha mask with an opacity multiplier of 1.0. Digit size and color are fixed, and digit classes are not explicitly balanced.
blocks.zh: 相片被中-克缩为正方形并被调整为512×512 512\times 512像素. 每个目标都收到一个与替换一致的MNIST样本. 训练图像使用MNIST训练集,而验证图像使用MNIST试验集. 数字被调整为224×224 2.24\times 224像素使用双线插值并用白色渲染. 左上方的坐标由{0,...,288}}\0,\ldots 288}沿每个轴被统一取样,将数字补丁保留在图像内. 我们用调整的数位强度作为阿尔法口罩,不透明乘以1.0. 数字大小和颜色是固定的,而数字类没有明确的平衡.

blocks.en: Linear-probe and clustering evaluations use 24,739 target validation images. The per-class counts for digits 0–9 are 2,464, 2,699, 2,685, 2,521, 2,358, 2,199, 2,337, 2,613, 2,400, and 2,463.

The original FFHQ dataset does not provide attribute-level labels indicating whether a face wears glasses. We use the eyewear annotations from the FFHQ Features Dataset ( DCGM, ) , which were generated automatically using Microsoft’s Azure Face API, to construct the background and target datasets. During training, we use 10,000 images without glasses as the background dataset and 10,000 images with glasses as the target dataset. Because the annotations are automatic, they can contain errors. After our manual audit of all 3,437 validation images (Appendix A.5 ), the validation set contains 2,636 images with reading glasses, 762 with sunglasses, and 39 without glasses.
blocks.zh: 最初的FFHQ数据集没有提供属性级别标签,说明一面是否戴眼镜. 我们使用来自FFHQ Features Datas集(DCGM, )的眼衣说明, 使用微软的 Azure Face API 自动生成, 来构建背景和目标数据集 。 在训练期间,我们使用一万个没有眼镜的图像作为背景数据集,一万个有眼镜的图像作为目标数据集. 由于说明是自动的,因此可以包含出错. 经过我们对所有3,437个验证图像(Appendix A.5.)的人工审核后,验证集包含有2,636个有读取眼镜的图像,762个有太阳镜的图像,39个没有眼镜的图像.

blocks.en: We use the OCT-Kermany data of Kermany et al. (2018) , treating normal scans as background and CNV, DME, and DRUSEN scans jointly as target. The original Kermany export contains saturated-white borders introduced by acquisition tilt or registration correction, rather than by our dataset construction. These borders can extend 300 pixels into a 496-pixel-high scan. Before cleaning, 60.1% of the 109,309 scans have at least one edge for which more than half the pixels are saturated white, creating an easily exploitable non-anatomical cue for an encoder.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Kermany等人(2018年)的OCT-Kermany数据,将正常扫描作为背景和CNV,DME,DRUSEN扫描联合作为目标. 最初的Kermany出口包含通过收购倾斜或注册修正而不是通过我们的数据集构建引入的饱和-白边界. 这些边框可以将300像素扩展为496像素高的扫描. 在打扫前,109,309个扫描器中,60.1%至少有一个边缘,其中超过一半的像素是饱和白色,为编码器创造了一个易于被利用的非解剖提示.

blocks.en: We preprocess scans in grayscale. First, we remove rows or columns that are at least 95% white (intensity ≥ 0.90 \geq 0.90 ) along their full extent. To preserve retinal tissue under oblique white wedges, we then replace only near-white regions connected to an image boundary and larger than 64 pixels, rather than rectangularly cropping to the deepest wedge. Replacement pixels are Gaussian noise matched to the mean and standard deviation of the darkest 40% of pixels in the scan, which correspond to the vitreous. Scans for which this replacement would cover over 60% of the image are retained unchanged. Finally, we preserve aspect ratio, bicubically resize to height 384, and center-crop to 384 × 384 384\times 384 before storing RGB images. This avoids the aspect-ratio distortions caused by directly resizing the eight native scan widths to a square. During representation learning, images are resized from 384 384 to 256 256 for DINOv3, without data augmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们用灰度扫描流程 首先,我们删除至少95%为白色(强度为 0.90\克0.90)的行或列。 为了在斜白楔形下保存视网膜组织,我们然后只取而代之的是连接于图像边界并大于64像素的近白区域,而不是长方形收割到最深的楔形. 替换像素是高斯噪声,与扫描中最黑暗的40%像素的平均值和标准偏差相匹配,这与华丽相匹配. 该替换将覆盖60%以上图像的扫描装置保持不变。 最后,在存储RGB图像之前,我们保留了外观比,双相调整为高384,中相调整为384×384384\时. 这避免了由将8个本土扫描宽度直接调整为正方形而引发的侧面-比例扭曲. 在进行代表学习期间,图像从384 384到256 256的DINOv3,没有增加数据。

blocks.en: Table 8 gives the resulting splits. We train on the cleaned training set (97,478 scans). All OCT evaluations use the official 1,000-image test set, whose patients do not appear in training.
blocks.zh: 表8列出了由此造成的拆分。 我们用清洁的训练设备(97 478个扫描仪)训练。 所有OCT评价都使用官方的1000-图像测试集,其患者不出现在培训中.

blocks.en: B.2 Baseline Details
blocks.zh: B.2 基线细节

blocks.en: We use the default configurations of the generative CA baselines cVAE ( Abid and Zou, 2019 ) , SepVAE ( Louiset et al., 2023 ) , and Double-InfoGAN ( Carton et al., 2024 ) , and of the contrastive CA baseline SepCLR ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) . Double-InfoGAN uses its native 128 × 128 128\times 128 input resolution; all remaining baselines use 256 × 256 256\times 256 inputs. DINOv3 + SepCLR trains SepCLR’s objectives on SAGE’s frozen RAEv2 encoder with the same common/salient encoder architecture (Appendix B.3 ), isolating the contribution of the training framework from that of the visual backbone. We additionally evaluate the unfactorized RAEv2 latent z z (DINOv3 with MLS), denoted DINOv3 in figures. For generation, Raw DINOv3 GMP pools z z identically to salient conditioning, so the two conditions differ only in whether the salient encoder is applied.
blocks.zh: 我们使用基因CA基线cVAE(Abid and Zou, 2019), SepVAE(Louiset等, 2023),和 Double-InfoGAN(Carton等, 2024)以及对比CA基线SepCLR(Louiset等, 2024)的默认配置. Double-InfoGAN使用其原生的128×128128\times 128输入分辨率;所有剩余基线使用256×256256\times 256输入. DINOv3 + SepCLR 训练 SepCLR 的目标在 SAGE 所冻结的 RAEv2 编码器上,具有相同的通用/恒定编码器架构(Appendix B.3 ),将训练框架的贡献与视觉主干体的贡献隔离开来. 此外,我们还评估了未实现的RAEv2潜在z z(DINOv3与MLS),在数字中表示DINOv3。 对于生成,Raw DINOv3 GMP池 z z z 与显式条件相同,因此这两个条件仅在显式编码器是否被应用上有所不同.

blocks.en: B.3 DINOv3 + SepCLR Baseline
blocks.zh: B.3 DINov3 + SepCLR 基线

blocks.en: DINOv3 + SepCLR shares SAGE’s frozen RAEv2 encoder (DINOv3-L with multi-layer summation and RAEv2 latent normalization) and common/salient encoder architecture, and differs in its objectives and evaluation readout (Table 9 ). Each branch applies global average pooling (GAP), following SepCLR, to obtain a 1,024-dimensional vector. A fully connected layer maps it to the 32-dimensional representation used for evaluation. A separate MLP projector ( → → BN → ReLU → 32 32\!\to\!128\!\to\!\mathrm{BN}\!\to\!\mathrm{ReLU}\!\to\!32 , with batch normalization, BN) supplies only the contrastive and k k -JEM losses; its output is not used for evaluation. Only the two common/salient Transformers, two fully connected layers, and two projectors are trained. We retain SepCLR’s alignment, uniformity, salient regularization, and JEM losses and its original loss hyperparameters ( Louiset et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: DINOv3 + SepCLR 共享SAGE被冻结的 RAEv2 编码器(DINOv3-L 带有多层总和和和 RAEv2 潜在正常化)和 常见/saily 编码器架构,并在目标和评价读取上存在差异(表9 ). 每个分支在SepCLR之后应用全局平均集合(GAP)来得到1,024维向量. 将它与用于评价的32维表示图完全连接。 一个单独的MLP投影机(~~ BN~ ReLU~ 32 32\!\to\!128\!!\ mathrm{BN→!\to\!\ mathrm{ReLU}!\to\ 32, 批量常态化, BN)只提供对比性和克-JEM损失;其输出不用于评价. 只有两个共通/相通变形器,两个全相通的地层,两个投影器都经过了训练. 我们保留了SepCLR的调整、统一、突出的正规化,以及正义运动的损失及其最初的损失超参数(Louiset等,2024年)。

blocks.en: B.4 Linear-Probe Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.4 线性勘探评价

blocks.en: We use the evaluation pools defined in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用附录B.1所界定的评价集合。

blocks.en: We evaluate frozen representations with stratified five-fold cross-validation. We standardize the features and evaluate them using a logistic-regression classifier. No class weighting is used, and predictions are scored using ordinary accuracy, as the digit classes are approximately balanced. Reported digit linear-probe scores are mean accuracies across the five folds.
blocks.zh: 我们用五倍的交叉验证来评估冻结的表述。 我们把特征标准化,并使用后勤后退分类器对其进行评估。 不使用类加权法,预测使用普通精度来打分,因为数字类大致平衡. 被报道的数位线性探测分数是五折相间的平均值.

blocks.en: We evaluate frozen salient representations on all 3,398 images with the manually verified reading-glasses/sunglasses labels, using class-balanced logistic regression and stratified five-fold cross-validation. The score is balanced accuracy, the mean of the two class recalls. Table 1 reports the mean across folds. The main FFHQ SAGE result uses target salient sparsity weight λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 .
blocks.zh: 我们评估所有3 398幅图像上被冻结的显著显示,并使用手动核实的读取镜/太阳镜标签,采用分类平衡的物流回归并分级进行五倍的交叉验证。 分数是平衡的准确度,两个分数的平均值会回顾. 表1报告各行各业的平均值。 主要FFHQ SAGE结果使用目标突出的斯帕西分量 QQ=0.01\lambda=0.01.

blocks.en: B.5 Clustering and t-SNE Protocol
blocks.zh: B.5 集群和T-SNE议定书

blocks.en: Clustering uses only target-group salient representations, extracted with the trained encoders frozen. The baseline representations used for evaluation are flat vectors: 32 dimensions for SepCLR and DINOv3 + SepCLR and 64 for cVAE, SepVAE, and Double-InfoGAN. SAGE produces an N × 1024 N\times 1024 salient token representation, which we reduce to a 1,024-dimensional vector by channel-wise global max pooling (GMP) over the token axis, as in linear-probe evaluation. These pooled SAGE vectors define SAGE’s original salient representation space. Within each quantitative evaluation setting, all methods use the same images and labels.
blocks.zh: 集群只使用目标组突出的表示,被被训练有素的编码器所取出. 用于评价的基准表示是平向量:SepCLR和DINOv3 + SepCLR为32维;CVAE、SepVAE和Double-InfoGAN为64维. SAGE产生一个 N × 1024 N\times 1024 显著的符号表示法,我们通过在符号轴上通过信道的全局最大集合(GMP),像线性探测评价那样,将它减少到了1,024维向量. 这些集合的SAGE向量定义了SAGE最初的显著表现空间. 在每一定量评价设置中,所有方法都使用相同的图像和标签.

blocks.en: We use the evaluation pools defined in Appendix B.1 . For all methods, the number of clusters is set to the number of evaluation classes: k = 10 k=10 for Digits-ImageNet, and k = 2 k=2 or k = 3 k=3 for the two FFHQ settings with audited labels, and k = 3 k=3 for the three OCT-Kermany diseases. Table 1 uses the FFHQ two-class setting, while Table 4 reports both settings.
blocks.zh: 我们使用附录B.1所界定的评价集合。 对于所有方法,集群数被设定为评价类数:克=10克=10为Digits-ImageNet,克=2克=2或克=3为两个FFHQ设置并有被审计标签,克=3克为3为OCT-Kermany三种疾病. 表1采用FFHQ两等设置,而表4则报告两种设置.

blocks.en: For qualitative visualization only, we obtain two-dimensional embeddings using scikit-learn t-SNE ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) . Pairwise cosine distances are computed from the full normalized feature vectors. The first two principal components provide the initial two-dimensional coordinates, which t-SNE then optimizes. We use perplexity 30, an automatic learning rate, and 1,000 iterations, with a fixed random seed.
blocks.zh: 只为了定性可视化,我们用 scikit-learn t-SNE 获得二维嵌入(van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008.). 从完全正常的特性向量计算出对等的同位素距离。 前两个主要组件提供了初始的二维坐标,然后被t-SNE优化. 我们使用30分,自动学习率, 和1000分迭接, 固定随机种子。

blocks.en: For both FFHQ and Digits-ImageNet, we use four NVIDIA H200 GPUs with 32 images per GPU, giving a global batch size of 128 (approximately 64 background and 64 target images). The DINOv3 backbone and RAE decoder remain frozen, as does the discriminator’s feature-extraction backbone; only the common/salient encoders and discriminator heads are optimized.

blocks.en: Both datasets use a Decoupled Diffusion Transformer initialized from RAEv2’s EMA-averaged ImageNet DINOv3-L/16 K7 checkpoint, with all parameters fine-tuned. The model predicts the clean latent, the full normalized DINOv3 latent of shape 1024 × 16 × 16 1024\times 16\times 16 given by the K7 multi-layer sum over blocks { 11 , 13 , … , 23 } \{11,13,\ldots,23\} . The frozen Stage 1 models are those described in Appendix C.2 . Global max pooling of SAGE’s salient latent produces a 1,024-dimensional vector, projected into one condition token with dropout probability 0.1. Both use logit-normal time sampling with parameters ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) and t_eps = 0.05 =0.05 .

blocks.en: We investigate how much a Stage-2 model varies its output under a fixed conditioning image as the initial noise changes by computing the Vendi Score ( Friedman and Dieng, 2023 ) from the eigenvalues of the CLS output of DINOv2-L ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) ( facebook/dinov2-large ). Diversity must be measured within a reference for non-target attribute variation to be visible: scored across a set spanning many references, the variation among the references themselves enters the number, and a model that copies each reference would appear diverse on inherited variation alone. We report these results in Table 2 .

blocks.en: We draw reference images by stratified random sampling from the target validation images. For FFHQ, we sample 30 images from each manually verified eyewear subtype—reading glasses and sunglasses—for 60 images total; for Digits-ImageNet, we sample 10 images for each digit class (100 images total). Each reference image is paired with K = 16 K=16 independently generated noise samples. SAGE and Raw DINOv3 GMP use the identical reference lists and initial noises, pairing generated samples image by image. SAGE pools the Stage 1 salient representations with global max pooling (GMP), whereas Raw DINOv3 GMP bypasses the salient encoder and pools the original Stage 1 DINOv3 features with GMP. The two Stage 2 models are trained separately with the same training budget.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: Background/target labels do not uniquely determine how correlated attributes are split between the two factors. The common representation retains linearly decodable digit information (probe accuracy 0.336 0.336 , comparable to 0.328 0.328 for the unfactorized latent; Table 7 ), although common-only decoding removes the digit (Fig. 4 ). SAGE therefore yields a clean salient factor rather than an exclusive assignment of target information to it.
blocks.zh: 背景/目标标签并不独有地决定两个因素之间如何分割相关属性. 常见的表示法保留了线性可解码的位数信息(可能准确性为0.336 0.336,与未构型的潜入物相仿为0.328 0.328;表7.),虽然常见的去除位数(图4.). 因此,SAGE产生一个干净的突出因素,而不是向它专门分配目标信息。

blocks.en: SAGE inherits the representation and reconstruction priors of its frozen encoder and decoder, which are pretrained on natural images. Reconstruction on OCT-Kermany is accordingly less faithful than on natural images (SSIM 0.448 0.448 versus 0.571 0.571 on Digits-ImageNet and 0.723 0.723 on FFHQ; Table 6 ). Because SAGE keeps the autoencoder frozen, a representation autoencoder pretrained on biomedical images could replace RAEv2 without changing the method.
blocks.zh: SAGE继承了被冷冻的编码器和解码器的表示与重建前科,这些编码和解码器在自然影像上预先被训练. 因此,OCT-Kermany上的重建不如自然图像上的那么忠实(SSIM 0.448 0.448 与 Digits-ImageNet 0.571 0.571和FFHQ 0.723 0.723;表6)。 由于SAGE保持自定义编码器被冷冻,在生物医学影像上预先被训练的表示式自定义编码器可以在不改变方法的情况下取代RAEv2.
